name: The Legend of Ogorets #4: Warren
source:
#4 is the adventure of Warren, an energetic mercenary, embarks upon an epic journey to find the perfect place to plant his telescope at night.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2703030/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
#4是沃伦的冒险故事，他是一位精力充沛的雇佣兵，踏上了史诗般的旅程，寻找夜间安装望远镜的完美地点。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2703030/]Steam[/url]]
